items.html: And behold, it was explained above that phase one is the Mem, corresponding to the four Yudin of HaVaYaH of Yudin, and phase two is the Lamed of Tzelem, which corresponds to the three Yudin of Ehyeh of Yudin, for this Tzelem is the phase of these from AVI, called HaVaYaH and Ehyeh of Yudin, which were extended as above; and therefore these two names are alluded to in all three phases of the Tzelem.
